svg.title: How Panter-ai fits together
svg.desc: Diagram. Left: AI hosts (Claude as leader; GPT-A, GPT-B, Grok and Gemini as workers) connect to Panter-ai over MCP. Center: Panter-ai with its automatic harness, review gate, mesh and workforce, GitHub workforce, Engram memory and per-role tool surface. Right: downstream MCP servers, each in its own repository and service, reached through Panter with per-server tokens and write grants. Bottom: GitHub, where pull requests, CI and an independent reviewer account gate every merge.
